description: Election Commission - Declare that H. M. Azmy as a member of the Pathadumbara P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pathadumbara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member through the electoral process, which falls under electoral matters and procedures.
